functional_summary.overview: Single flip-flop sequential circuit. On each posedge of clk, the flip-flop updates its state to the value of the combinational next-state function of inputs a, b and current state. Output q equals the registered state.
rules: On posedge clk: state <= next_state, where next_state is a boolean function of (a, b, state).
Output q is the registered state (q == state).
From the waveform, next_state = a XOR b XOR state (i.e., state toggles when a XOR b is 1, holds when a XOR b is 0).
No reset; initial state is unspecified (x) until first posedge with defined inputs.
